validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: starting from the sheet's own wiki citations and verifying live: (1) PNGRB's official 'Natural Gas Pipeline Networks in India' register (pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/NGPL-for%20Website-1.11.16.pdf, Nov 2016 edition) lists this exact project under 'Pipelines Under Construction' -- row 25: 'Kakinada - Vizag - Srikakulam', entity 'Andhra Pradesh Gas Distribution Corp. Ltd.', length 391.0 km, capacity 90.000 MMSCMD, authorisation date 16.07.2014 (confirmed via pdftotext -- the URL 200s but the automated substring screen misses 'Kakinada', a known PDF-extraction false-negative per url_verifier.py's own documented caveats; I manually read the extracted text). (2) The Times of India, 2 Jul 2017 ('Piped gas project in Andhra Pradesh gains steam'), reports APGDC awarded a work order for the Kakinada-Visakhapatnam first phase, with the wider Kakinada-Srikakulam line under a live PNGRB authorisation. (3) Total Energy Informatics, 7 Aug 2015 (archived), reports APGDC -- a 50/50 JV of the Andhra Pradesh government and GAIL Gas Ltd -- had begun work on a 301-km Kakinada-Srikakulam line across East Godavari, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam districts. (4) GAIL's own Nov 2022 press release on its Srikakulam-Angul pipeline explicitly references interconnecting at Srikakulam with 'Kakinada-Srikakulam Pipeline of Andhra Pradesh Gas Distribution Corporation (APGDC)' as a real, expected counterpart project. (5) DMS Universe, an independent commercial project-intelligence database, separately carries this project (391 km, 90 MMSCMD, APGDC). Five independent sources across 2015-2022, all agreeing this was a real, PNGRB-authorized, partially-tendered pipeline -- not fabricated. CANCELLATION: PNGRB's own public notice PN08012024.pdf (already the sheet's cited ref) states verbatim (confirmed by direct pdftotext read, since the automated screen's PDF extraction misses the relevant page): 'PNGRB vide letter dated 16.07.2014 authorized Andhra Pradesh Gas Distribution Corporation Limited for development of Kakinada-Srikakulam Natural Gas Pipeline (KSPL) ... the Board vide letter dated 01.12.2023 cancelled the authorization of the said pipeline due to various reasons.' This is a CONFIRMED cancellation (a regulator formally cancelling its own authorisation), not an inferred dormancy -- see status_reviews and the ShelvedCancelledType fix below. CLASSIFICATION: transmission is correct -- the notice itself describes the line connecting to GAIL's KG Basin Natural Gas Pipeline Network, PIL's East-West Natural Gas Pipeline, IMC's Kakinada-Vijaywada-Nellore pipeline, and GAIL's Srikakulam-Angul pipeline: an inter-network trunk line under PNGRB's NGPL common-carrier framework, not a gathering/distribution/CGD line. DUPLICATE CHECK vs roster: checked P3342 'Kakinada-Haldia Gas Pipeline' (same Kakinada origin, but continuing far past Srikakulam into West Bengal, and essentially unpopulated on the sheet -- len/dia/cap all blank). Route overlap at the Kakinada-Srikakulam segment is plausible if P3342 represents an early, vaguer conception of the same north-coastal grid before it was split into named sub-projects, but I found no source treating P3342 and P0932 as the same physical proposal, so I am not flagging a hard duplicate -- worth a cross-check when P3342 itself is audited. SUCCESSOR: gem.wiki independently carries a second, distinct page (article ID 134847, categorised 'Proposed Pipelines in India') titled 'Kakinada-Srikakulam Gas Pipeline' describing PNGRB's Jan 2024 suo-motu re-proposal at 20 MMSCMD, status 'Proposed' -- this is a genuinely new/different entity (smaller design capacity, no sponsor yet named, restarted from scratch), not P0932 relabelled, so P0932's cancellation stands as a real closure of the old authorisation rather than a name change. (Read only for context/leads -- not cited per standing rule 1.)

MMSCMD') both state 391 km. No source anywhere -- including the sheet's own cited wiki references -- gives 275 km; the closest independent figures are earlier press estimates of 301 km (Total Energy Informatics, 2015) and a probable 309-km figure in a 2017 ToI article (likely referring to the same whole-corridor total, garbled in that article's phrasing), both of which are closer to 391 than to 275 and plausibly reflect an earlier, less-refined route estimate before the final 391-km authorised alignment. status_reviews.researcher_notes: This is a CONFIRMED cancellation, not a dormancy inference -- closing one of the 8 blank-ShelvedCancelledType rows in this cluster. So: (1) ShelvedCancelledType should be set to 'confirmed', not left blank -- a regulator explicitly cancelled its own authorisation, the textbook 'confirmed' case; no fabricated URL needed, the sheet's existing ref already supports it once actually read.
